ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Poison Forest
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
POISONFOREST_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 (Phase A row 10 of the biome-mod-architecture split). A low, wet-black forest standing in permanent dusk over ground that breathes a cold, metal-rich gas. Fully generalized: it names no other franchise or campaign and is playable standalone on any generated RimWorld planet. A separate frozen campaign world's own Poison Forest instance is unaffected and unrelated; this is a new sibling biome for everyone else's worlds, not a rename of that one.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it.
Ships the biome and its own placement worker (RM_BiomeWorker_PoisonForest, replacing the donor BiomesPlus.BiomeWorker_PoisonForest — a donor type in workerClass is a hard dependency the RimMandrake tier may not assume), two new terrain defs (RM_PoisonSoil / RM_PoisonSoilRich, replacing the donor BiomesPlus terrain names the twin used with no def backing them anywhere in this repo), three renamed-and-duplicated flora ThingDefs (RM_TwistingThornwood, RM_TreeMartyr, RM_DarkCrust — the frozen twin's own RUT_-prefixed copies stay in place unchanged, serving the live campaign world and RUT_CrackedLands, which still shares RM_TwistingThornwood's species; this mod's copies are its own, per the "duplicate, then diverge" rule for content wired into two biome mods), 13 non-Star-Wars fauna rows inline, and a Mod Settings screen with the standard worldgen-rarity master toggle (MOD_OPTIONS_RETROFIT_1 doctrine — defaults = shipped behavior, 0 = never generates).
⚠️ Unlike the fully donor-free mods, this one is NOT donor-free: six wildPlants entries (AB_CrystalFlower, AB_BloodBouquet, AB_RavenNettle, AB_GiantAgariTox, AB_RedBugloss, AB_KeeningCordax, AB_GiantToxicFlower — Alpha Biomes) and the world-map texture (Biomes/PoisonForest, BiomesPlus) carry no MayRequire, inherited unchanged from the frozen campaign twin — not this build's scope to fix. Alpha Biomes is required for full flora variety; the inline fauna rows (Genetic Rim, Alpha Animals, Alpha Memes, Horrors) are individually MayRequire'd and degrade gracefully without them.
NOT in this mod: the Star Wars-tier fauna (Neebray, Mynock, GraniteSlug, RSW_Screecher, RSW_VentStalker) that inhabit this biome in the campaign — those ride a Utinni patch onto this mod's own RM_PoisonForest def rather than living inside it, per the Q11a naming-tier ruling. The toxic-meat Star Wars cuisine chain and any other campaign plot content stay in Utinni entirely.
